mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines for 3 consecutive months, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals labor market deterioration, triggering short-term equity sell-offs and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.3pp, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in housing starts (HOUST) and decline in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates a supply-side disruption in manufacturing while housing demand remains strong, causing stagflationary pressures and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST MoM change > 0.5% and INDPRO MoM change < -0.5%
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 300), a monthly CPI decline exceeding 0.2 percentage points signals successful disinflation, reducing aggressive tightening risks and producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL declines > 0.2% in a high-inflation regime, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly housing starts increase exceeding 1.0% signals robust consumer demand for housing, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as economic resilience strengthens.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when HOUST increases > 1.0%, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in industrial production signals expanding manufacturing output and economic growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO rises for 3 consecutive months, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in payroll employment (PAYEMS) exceeding 0.5% and decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 0.1 percentage points indicates a rapidly strengthening labor market, supporting consumer spending and corporate earnings for positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS MoM change > 0.5% and UNRATE declines > 0.1pp from prior month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion (GDPC1 annualized growth < 2%), a monthly real personal consumption expenditure increase exceeding 0.3% signals resilient consumer demand that offsets slowing GDP growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when RSAFS increases > 0.3% in a late-cycle expansion, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.
